title: Systematic Trading & Backtesting
subtitle: Turn a trading rule into pandas code, test it without fooling yourself, and decide with a written gate stack whether it ever trades.
what_you_learn: Write a rule as code with next-bar execution and no look-ahead, and run it on real SPY bars pulled from Yahoo Finance with verified row counts
Model spread, commission and impact per side and see exactly how a 10 bps cost takes a mean-reversion edge from +3.5% to +1.2% a year
Catch leakage with the truncation-invariance test and the intrabar-fill check, including the leak that turns a 0.14 Sharpe into 2.69
Run a parameter sweep, measure that in-sample ranking predicts nothing out-of-sample (Spearman -0.15), and compute a deflated Sharpe ratio
Split data into anchored walk-forward folds, report expectancy, exposure-diluted Sharpe, drawdown and tail against a T-bill cash benchmark
Write and apply a pass/fail gate stack with real thresholds, then carry a survivor to a reconciled paper book with a kill switch
